text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Hello... what does the Grand
Concert mean
to you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want you to answer not as a runner, but
as a fan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...You were a fan, weren't you? You
wanted to
see that special someone on
stage.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: What does the Grand Concert mean to the fans?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt, bzzt!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hello? This is Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Is this the place?

text_block_list.name: Woman in Suit
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's her! Hey, so when are you guys
doing the
Grand Concert?

text_block_list.name: Man with Hat
text_block_list.text:
I always enjoy the concerts you guys put
on here.
Is there anything I can do to
help?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
If you have any posters, I'd be glad to
put them
up in my store...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Do you know them?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Fans?

text_block_list.name: Fan in Dress
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a concert where anyone can
perform,
right? I'm hoping I might get to
see my oshi on
stage...

text_block_list.name: Fan with Chef Hat
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to pitch in. Normally, we can't
do much
more than just show up and
watch.

text_block_list.name: Fan with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
We heard you need supporters? I mean,
I know
you're mainly looking for
Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything at all we can help out
with?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: There's... so many of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans come up to us one after another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These concerts were originally meant to
attract
more students to our cause, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems word has spread far beyond the
academy
gates.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Could we go back to doing these
concerts? I
think the folks here would
appreciate it too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Great!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I have a request for all of you going
forward.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'd like to change up the format a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What about it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I want to let fans be more vocal during
the
performance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hrmm?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure things will get noisier than
before, and
you might have a little
trouble hearing.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But I've already notified the fans, our
audio
engineer, and city hall about that.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So please... I want you to listen to your
fans'
voices.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It'd be amazing if you made the Grand
Concert
happen!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Every fan wants to see their favorite
runner stand
center stage in a winning
concert—it's what we
live for.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
But the feelings we want to convey to
them go
beyond just "congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. We had so many more
feelings than
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon enough, the concert begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Smart Falcon and the others go
out on
stage...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
L-O-V-E, lovely! Falco is every fan's
dream! Falco
is the number one Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I love how you shine brighter than
anyone! I love
love looove youuu!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, you're my idol! No matter
what, you stay strong and beautiful, and
never give in!
You're everything I
dreamed of!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, my beloved! Take me with you
into the
unknown! No, let me watch over
you on your way
there!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Suzukaaa! Thanks for letting us see you
again!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: That's all the happiness we need!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thank you so much, all of
you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa, what's wrong, Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't know. I don't know, but perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am feeling... "happy."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there's lots we want to tell each
other
today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...So let's sing together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to bring the Grand
Concert
back—I'm more sure of that than
ever.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to say a big thank you to the
girls,
from
us... and from the fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going back to the drawing board
with our
project.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This time, it'll be a concert not just for
the
Umamusume, but for their fans as
well.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
They're at it again... Why can't they
understand?

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Are you... not going to sing?

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're...
